newsitem.title: USA: Copley Pharm gets early FDA drug approval.
newsitem.headline: Copley Pharm gets early FDA drug approval.

text.p: Copley Pharmaceuticals said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved the company's Abbreviated New Drug Application for its pain management and anti-inflamatory drug, Diclofenac Sodium Delayed-release tablets.
In a statement, Copley said it can now manufacture and market the generic drug, which will be available only by prescription. It is equivalent to Ciba-Geigy's Voltaren delayed-release tablets.
Diclofenac Sodium is a non-steroidal anti-inflamatory drug used to help reduce the acute and chronic pain of rheumatoid arthritis.
